questions.answer: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is a strategic framework for making sure your brand appears in AI-generated search results and recommendations. It involves optimizing your digital footprint so AI systems recognize your brand as authoritative, relevant, and trustworthy, which covers content strategy, entity optimization, reputation signals, and technical implementation [6]. Joe describes GEO as broader and longer term than AEO, focused on making a brand a recognized entity that AI systems mention by name [5]. Joe also notes that GEO depends on solid technical SEO, since AI search tools need content to be accessible and properly structured [8].

questions.answer: Per this site's FAQ, SEO is a long-term investment, and timelines depend on your starting point, competition, and objectives. Technical fixes and quick wins can show impact within weeks, meaningful organic traffic growth typically appears between three and six months, and substantial, compounding results are often visible at six to twelve months [1]. AI visibility (AEO and GEO) can shift faster because AI platforms update their knowledge bases [1]. For a timeline specific to your situation, see the contact page at /contact/.
